FileSpec.description: A file the operator writes on a managed machine.

content.description: Literal file body, written as-is. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

mode.description: Octal permission bits applied after the write. Default: `0644`.

path.description: Destination path on the machine. A leading `~` expands to the home directory of the user the agent runs as.

source.description: Path the body is read from instead of `content`, resolved against the machine's config directory.

ModuleRef.description: Reference to a module that should be installed on the machine.

name.description: Name of the cluster-scoped `Module` resource to install.

required.description: Whether a failure to resolve or install this module fails the whole reconcile. Default: `false`, so a missing module is reported and the rest of the machine still converges.

PackageRef.description: Reference to a package with optional version pin.

name.description: Package name as the machine's own package manager knows it.

version.description: Exact version to pin to. Omitted, whatever the manager currently offers is installed and left alone once present.

files.description: Files to write on the machine, either inline or fetched from a source path.

hostname.description: Hostname of the machine this document describes. The agent reconciles only the MachineConfig whose hostname matches its own.

moduleRefs.description: Modules to install on the machine, each naming a cluster-scoped `Module` resource.

packages.description: Packages to install on top of whatever the profile declares, each optionally version-pinned.

profile.description: Name of the profile the machine reconciles against. Resolved on the machine, from its own config directory or from a subscribed source.

systemSettings.description: System configurator settings to apply, keyed by `<configurator>.<setting>` (e.g. `sysctl.net.ipv4.ip_forward`). Empty, no system settings are reconciled.
